name: Doors & Windows
tagline: Openings — where security, acoustics and weather are decided
description: Doors and windows are the only interior elements that also have to be building envelope. This section covers door types by construction and rating, then window systems by frame material, since that single choice drives thermal, acoustic and maintenance performance for the life of the building.

materials.name: Flush door
materials.blurb: Solid or hollow core door — the internal standard
materials.description: A timber frame with board facings, in solid or hollow core. Solid core is heavier, quieter and takes a mortise lock properly; hollow core belongs on cupboards, not bedrooms.

materials.name: Veneer door
materials.blurb: Flush door faced in real timber and polished
materials.description: The finish upgrade for main and bedroom doors: veneer on both faces, polished in PU with matching edge lipping. Order doors and frames as a set so grain and tone match.

materials.name: Laminate door
materials.blurb: Laminate-faced door — hard-wearing and easy to clean
materials.description: A pressed laminate face that shrugs off knocks and cleaning, which is why it dominates rental, hostel and commercial work. Available pre-finished with matching architraves.

materials.name: Glass door
materials.blurb: Frameless or framed toughened glass for light and openness
materials.description: 10–12 mm toughened glass on patch fittings or a slim frame. Beautiful in studies and bathrooms; always add manifestation and check the floor spring load rating.

materials.name: Fire-rated door
materials.description: The rating belongs to the whole assembly — leaf, frame, hinges, closer and seals — not just the leaf. Substituting any component voids the certificate, which fire consultants do check.

materials.name: Pocket door
materials.blurb: Slides into a cavity inside the wall — zero swing space
materials.description: The answer for tight bathrooms and study entries where a swing door would block the room. The cavity frame must go in during the wall build, so it is an early decision.

materials.name: Sliding door
materials.blurb: Surface-sliding leaf on a top track
materials.description: Barn-style or channel-mounted sliders save the swing area without touching the wall build. Top-hung systems run more smoothly than bottom-rolling ones and keep the floor clean.

materials.name: Aluminium window
materials.blurb: Slim sightlines and long life, with a thermal-break option
materials.description: Powder-coated or anodised aluminium gives the thinnest frames and the largest glass area. Plain aluminium conducts heat, so specify a thermal break wherever the room is air-conditioned.

materials.name: uPVC window
materials.blurb: Best thermal and acoustic performance for the money
materials.description: Multi-chambered uPVC with steel reinforcement seals better than anything else at the price, cutting both noise and cooling load. Frames are chunkier than aluminium — check the sightlines against the elevation.

materials.name: Wooden window
materials.blurb: Traditional timber frames — warm, repairable, high-maintenance
materials.description: Nothing looks like real wood at a window reveal, and nothing needs as much upkeep in Indian monsoons. Use durable species and budget for repainting every few years.

materials.name: Sliding window
materials.blurb: Sashes that slide past each other — no swing into the room
materials.description: The Indian default: nothing projects, and half the opening ventilates. Sealing is inherently weaker than a casement, so specify good brush and gasket detailing on a noisy road.

materials.name: Casement window
materials.blurb: Side-hung sash that seals hard against the frame
materials.description: Compression seals make casements the best performer for weather-tightness and acoustics, and they open the full aperture for ventilation. They do swing, so check curtains and furniture.

materials.name: Tilt & turn window
materials.blurb: One handle, two modes — vent at the top or open fully
materials.description: Tilts inward for secure trickle ventilation and swings fully open for cleaning. The most practical high-rise window there is, and it cleans from inside the room.
